newsitem.title: USA: Yankee Energy to supply Connecticut firms.
newsitem.headline: Yankee Energy to supply Connecticut firms.

text.p: Yankee Energy System Inc said its Yankee Energy Services Co subsidiary was selected by the Manufacturing Alliance of Connecticut to manage the energy needs of its members.

The alliance was established in 1992 to preserve manufacturing jobs in Connecticut. In response to the deregulation of natural gas services which took place on April 1, it sought ways to help its member companies maximize buying power and reduce their total energy costs.
Over 50 of the alliance's members have shown an interest in the project, as well as several other large volume users of natural gas outside the manufacturing community.
